reproducibleNote: Exactly ONE build of this tree exists. No second, independent, byte-identical build has been attempted, so no reproducibility claim is made and no independentBuilds proof is recorded. The dependency closure below is also incomplete: the configure line enables YUZU_USE_CPM=ON with CPMUTIL_FORCE_BUNDLED=ON, so CPM fetched third-party sources at configure time that are NOT individually pinned here. Every gate in engines/phase3-registry.json stays false and shipped stays false. Packaging is opt-in only (LUCENT_INCLUDE_PHASE3_EDEN=1) and the Java NativeAdapterCatalog still requires the artifact sha256 below to match byte-for-byte before Switch resolves INTERNAL.

core.note: Cloned by commit from the upstream Gitea instance. No release tarball URL or archiveSha256 is recorded because none was downloaded; claiming an archive hash without fetching one would be false provenance.

toolchain.note: Recorded from the environment that produced the artifact below. Toolchain archive hashes are NOT pinned, which is one reason reproducible stays false.

cmakeOptions.note: Eden is a standalone Switch emulator with its own Android Activity. This profile builds its native library with the adapter translation unit compiled in and no Eden UI in Lucent's process; Lucent owns the surface, audio sink, pause/resume, save flushing, and teardown ordering.

patches.note: Compiled INTO Eden's own native library. Implements the lucent_native_adapter vtable and exports lucent_native_adapter_entry plus the lucent_eden_average_game_fps measurement hook.

artifact.note: MEASURED, not asserted. Both required exports are present and the PT_LOAD segments are 16 KiB aligned, but the library is NOT reduced to the adapter entry: it is Eden's whole native library (SONAME libyuzu-android.so) with the adapter compiled in, so it still exports Eden's, OpenSSL's, and FFmpeg's symbol tables. Lucent dlopens it by absolute path from the app-private native library directory, so the SONAME/filename difference does not affect loading, but -fvisibility=hidden plus --exclude-libs,ALL has NOT been applied and this artifact does not meet the one-exported-symbol goal recorded in engines/build_native_adapter.sh.

runtimeInputs.note: adapter_load() fails closed unless Lucent hands it a validated system directory (Common::FS::SetAppDirectory). Console keys and the system firmware archive are user-supplied at runtime and are NEVER packaged in the APK; see NativeAdapterSystemDirectory.

dependencies.note: Dependency closure stub. The build configured with YUZU_USE_CPM=ON and CPMUTIL_FORCE_BUNDLED=ON, so CPM fetched Eden's third-party sources at configure time. Each fetched package's repository/commit/archiveSha256 must be pinned here (mirroring engines/dolphin-source-lock.json) before this lock can claim a reproducible closure. Left populated with this note deliberately: no dependency has been audited or pinned yet.
